decision: Unselected. A shares one borrowed entropy reservoir within an MCU; B spans eligible ordinary scan blocks and vector-finds immutable-input nonFF ranges, removing repeated word masks without copying input. Both correct designs have mixed or unpromising complete short screens. No causal gain/loss/equivalence or independent confirmation follows. Qualified sources/main/embedded/bindings restored exactly, actual package unchanged. These implementations do not justify further variants without new evidence; no permanent family ban.
